title: ActivityMap navigation reference

behavior.activity: Detail opens beside the retained list. Close with X.
behavior.stats: A chart inspector opens on the right. X closes it; the selected tile stays compact.
behavior.filters: Left sidebar across Map, List and Stats. Portrait detail temporarily hides it; the toolbar can reveal it over the overview.
behavior.shell: Blue Map / List / Stats picker stays available while detail is open.
behavior.returnActivity: X returns to the full list. Show on map changes destination and selects the target route.
behavior.returnStats: Close the inspector with X, or activate the selected tile again. The overview remains mounted.
behavior.map: Portrait with filters uses a native results sheet; landscape fits a floating inspector on the right.
behavior.distinction: Portrait borrows the filter column for detail. Landscape can retain filters, overview and detail together.

layouts.title: Web · iPhone-size portrait
layouts.method: Chromium responsive viewport; no browser chrome

behavior.activity: The content area pushes to an activity page; the blue app header and sidebar remain visible.
behavior.stats: The selected tile expands inside the dashboard. The expand control becomes Collapse.
behavior.filters: Portrait keeps a narrow icon rail and expands filters over the content with a scrim. Landscape and desktop reserve space for the full sidebar.
behavior.shell: Map is the app-mark button. List and Stats are labeled; the blue shell stays available in detail.
behavior.returnActivity: Back to activities closes the content detail. The map action changes the browser route to Map.
behavior.returnStats: Collapse the selected tile, press Escape, or expand a different tile. This is not a separate chart page.
behavior.map: A floating results panel sits over the map. Its footprint depends on viewport width.
behavior.distinction: Phone landscape crosses into the full sidebar layout; the route panel can leave very little map visible.

captureNotes: Current working tree, not a released product specification. The saved checkpoint is dad01984; recent iPad adaptations are uncommitted.
63 full-resolution renders share the committed 20-activity review dataset. Photos and stream profiles are excluded; unavailable chart placeholders are expected.

Native iPhone views are hosted on the iPhone 18 Pro simulator, with actual scene rotation for landscape. iPad views use controlled 834×1194 and 1194×834 hosted windows on the iPad Pro 11-inch simulator; they are not physical-device screenshots.
Web captures use Chromium at 402×874, 874×402 and 1440×1000. They do not include Safari/Chrome chrome or browser safe-area effects.
Review fixture account chrome is used. The development-only sign-in overlay is excluded from web captures; authentication and account transitions are outside this reference.
Collections show representative entry and destination states, not continuous recordings. Native states are staged through production stores; browser details and Show on map use real controls.
Native Push is the capture baseline. The Dev tile-zoom alternative is not pictured. Static screenshots do not establish animation smoothness or swipe behavior.
Dates, basemap style and panel blur differ between clients. Review the containers, ownership of Back/Close and visible context; numerical/pixel parity is not the purpose.
The short web landscape map leaves a narrow usable map area. Captures preserve that actual state; the route-framing limitations are recorded in capture metadata.
